summary: This study looks at how new technology helps adults with type 2 diabetes who are starting insulin therapy when leaving the hospital. Researchers want to see if tools like a continuous glucose monitor and a smart insulin pen cap help patients follow their treatment plan. The trial includes 80 participants and is sponsored by Instituto de Investigacion Sanitaria La Fe. The status of this trial is Active, not recruiting.
